title: Bizgrowth360 Android App Build Configuration
description: Reusable configuration contract for the dynamic Android build engine. The same payload can be submitted by a future WordPress plugin API.

app_name.description: Android launcher display name. XML/AAPT metacharacters are escaped by the engine.

package_id.description: Android applicationId and namespace. At least two dot-separated segments.

website_url.description: HTTPS website loaded by the app. Dangerous schemes are rejected.

app_icon.description: Repository/project-relative path to a PNG/JPEG/WebP icon. Omit or null to use the generated default icon.

splash_image.description: Repository/project-relative path to a PNG/JPEG/WebP splash image. Omit or null to use the generated default splash.

icon_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL for a custom icon. Maximum 10 MB, minimum 192x192.

splash_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL for a custom splash image. Maximum 10 MB, minimum 320x320.

build_type.description: Artifact types to produce. Legacy values debug/release are accepted for Phase 2 compatibility.

allow_external_links.description: true opens non-site links in the system browser; false blocks them.
